Yachts 
The SeaDream Fleet 
Every yacht in the SeaDream fleet is built around the same idea. That luxury at sea is defined by an experience so personal and intimate that the pace is unhurried and it becomes entirely your own. Onboard, that means attentive service, exceptional cuisine, and an all-inclusive experience, leaving nothing for you to worry about. 
This is yachting, not cruising, and it's been the SeaDream standard since the beginning. 
SeaDream I & SeaDream II 
SeaDream I and SeaDream II are twin mega-yachts built around a single belief: that the finest way to travel by sea is aboard a private yacht, where the pace is yours and the experience is entirely your own. 
With 95 crew members looking after just 112 guests across 56 staterooms and suites, the level of service aboard these intimate boutique ships is unlike anything else at sea. Every stateroom and suite faces the sea, each offering luxury accommodations designed around the yachting lifestyle. As an all-inclusive luxury yacht, everything from the open bar to gratuities is taken care of. This is what yachting feels like. 
 Explore Yachts 
SeaDream III 
A new chapter is coming to SeaDream. 
After twenty-five years on the water, we're welcoming SeaDream III to the fleet. Her inaugural voyage is on the horizon, more details coming soon.

The Onboard Experience 
Life aboard SeaDream I & SeaDream II is defined by elegant informality. Mornings might begin with yoga on deck as the coastline drifts past. Afternoons open to watersports at sea from the Marina, a massage at the spa, or simply a Balinese Bed and the horizon. Evenings bring world-class cuisine under the stars. It feels less like a small ship cruise and more like a private yacht charter. 
Among boutique cruise lines, SeaDream stands apart. A luxury yachting vacation built around an intimate setting, ultra luxury service, and a crew that knows your name. Year after year, the world's most trusted travel publications return to SeaDream. The Condé Nast Traveler Gold List, Travel + Leisure, and Cruise Critic have each recognized what guests already know.

 IT’S YACHTING, NOT CRUISING | ENJOY THE DIFFERENCE 
SeaDream Yacht Club in 30 Seconds 
The expression “yachting” is not only a statement about size; it describes a lifestyle aboard the intimate vessels. Chic and stylish, SeaDream’s 56-stateroom twin yachts are favored for their elegant informality, personal service provided by a crew of 95, state-of-the-art facilities, inclusive open bar and gratuities, ocean view accommodations, luxury spa and world-class cuisine. Itineraries feature hidden yachting harbors and the smaller, less crowded ports of the Caribbean and the Mediterranean. 
Discover SeaDream Yacht Club 
Whether it's un-crowded sugar sand beaches or aged cobblestoned villages you’d like to explore, SeaDream will provide you unparalleled service, cuisine & amenities to enhance your vacation. Enjoy our award winning cuisine at a private table for two if you’d like, watch movies in the comfort of your plush Belgian bedding or take complimentary mountain bikes ashore for private exploration. Yachting is about choice. Be as active or relaxed as you wish. Our vacations are delightfully unstructured. Memories are made of this. 
Yacht Club Staterooms & Suites 
 SeaDream Yacht Club’s all ocean-view suites and staterooms blend luxury, intentional design, and total serenity at sea. Newly renovated Yacht Club Staterooms, Commodore Suites, and the elegant Admiral and Owner’s Suites feature nautically inspired décor, plush bedding, marble-lined bathrooms, and all-new furnishings. Enjoy modern amenities, a stocked minibar, 24-hour in-suite service, and personalized attention from our award-winning crew—your private sanctuary awaits. 
Expert Cuisine 
All gourmet meals are included in your voyage fare, and are prepared a la minute with only the freshest of ingredients. Join the chef ashore as he sources the best local ingredients for the evening’s feast. Special requests always welcome, and we a pleased to accommodate many dietary needs. Dine al fresco on deck or in the beautifully appointed Dining Salon. In-stateroom service from our “Small Bites” menu is also available 24 hours a day. Dining is a celebration at SeaDream. Just make sure to leave room for our decadent desserts. 
Award-Winning Service 
SeaDream’s award-winning 5-star service is second to none. From the moment you are welcomed aboard by the Captain it feels as if you are being welcomed onto your own private luxury yacht. With only a maximum of 112 pampered guests and an award-winning crew of 95, the crew to guest ratio provides each guest with SeaDream’s incomparable style and attention to detail. The bartender knows your name and what you would like to drink; your waiter knows how to surprise you with your favorite dessert. Once you experience our service you will be “Splendidly Spoiled” may never want to go on a cruise ship again. 
A rejuvenating experience awaits you at the SeaDream Spa. Discover the ultimate in Thai therapies and behold the secrets and luxury of their time honored spa treatments. Achieve pure bliss and tranquility in a sanctuary for you to relax, unwind, recharge and rejuvenate. Choose from an extensive range of spa favorites such as our Asian Blend massage, Soothing Aroma Massage and Traditional Thai Massage. The SeaDream Spa is an experience that you will surely want to return to again and again. 
Celebrate 
Yachting is a celebration of exploration, experience and life. There’s no better place to celebrate your special occasion than aboard one of our mega-yachts. From honeymoon & vow-renewal vacations, to Full Yacht Wedding Charters, SeaDream is the ultimate solution for your special day or event. Contact us to discuss your upcoming milestone celebration or corporate & incentive meeting. Many customization options are available for full yacht charters. Speak with a Charter Specialist today.

World-Class Destinations 
SeaDream offers luxury cruises of a lifetime to some of the most beautiful and breathtaking ports in the Caribbean  and Mediterranean . From November through April, our luxury yachts sail the turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea, calling on ports with some of the best beaches in the British Virgin Islands, Grenadines, French West Indies and other dream destinations such as St. Barts and Jost Van Dyke; a true guest favorite. If you wish to explore the rich history of the Mediterranean, set sail on a voyage between May and October as SeaDream I and II explore Spain, France, Italy, Greece and other notable historical and picturesque destinations. Providing the chance to relax on board and enjoy the many inclusive amenities, you may even cross the Atlantic with our award-winning crew from one region to the next on our Transatlantic itineraries. 
Escape to the Caribbean 
From November to April, there is no better luxury cruise experience at sea than a SeaDream Caribbean voyage. With a generous selection of exciting itineraries planned, Club Members can take advantage of a casual yet elegant yachting experience that can only be properly delivered on a SeaDream yacht cruise. As with any of our voyages, you can make your trip as personal as you wish and choose how you enjoy your time onboard. Yachting is about choice, and SeaDream offers a refreshingly un-structured vacation at sea; do what you want, when you want. The Caribbean is best known for its idyllic beaches and natural beauty, and our voyages are carefully planned to take you to these fabulous attractions. Beyond the scenery, we also strive to make your time in port as valuable as possible, allowing you to experience the dining and nightlife that the region is known for. Many of our voyages feature overnights in port so that you can experience the nightly excitement. Many of our guests enjoy our unique Yachting Land Adventures that aim to immerse you in the local experience to truly experience lifestyle and culture of these beautiful and exotic destinations. The culmination of your luxury Caribbean cruise is SeaDream’s Signature Champagne & Caviar Splash®. Enjoy free-flowing champagne and caviar followed by a special beach barbecue unlike any you have experienced before. With food prepared by our chef and crew served on bone china, you enjoy the flavors as intended and expect our signature Dream Cuisine style. Some of the tropical getaway destinations include: 
 Barbados 
 Saint Lucia 
 Saint Kitts 
 Saint Martin 
 The British Virgin Islands 
 Guadeloupe 
Feel like it’s time to plan your island getaway? Explore Caribbean Voyages.

Explore the Mediterranean Coast 
With many voyages from 7 to 14 days, our Mediterranean itineraries are the perfect way to explore this culturally rich region of the world. When you board as a guest on a luxury Mediterranean cruise , we strive to offer you as much comfort as the region has to offer. This includes the same on board amenities that you would expect from any of our other voyages and adds in its own set of unique Yachting Land Adventures. We are proud to offer a special Wine Voyage program to our guests who sail the Mediterranean. These unique sailings feature onboard wine tastings by select leading wineries from around the world. Featuring special itineraries that take you to some of the most famous wineries in the region, you’ll enjoy unique wine related Yachting Land Adventures and tastings as you make your way from exciting port to port. Whether you join us on a wine tasting cruise or on a wonderful standard itinerary, you’ll find there is plenty to do and see in the Mediterranean. We visit various ports throughout some of the most well-traveled cities in the Mediterranean, including: 
 Barcelona, Spain 
 Amalfi Coast in Italy 
 Saint Tropez, France 
 Athens, Greece 
 Monte Carlo, Monaco 
 Dubrovnik, Croatia 
Are you ready for a historical and exciting adventure? Explore Mediterranean Voyages.

Relax with a Transatlantic Crossing 
The ultimate voyage for those who appreciate life at sea, a Transatlantic trip takes you across the Atlantic, from one region to another. As you make your way across the sea, you will discover why our award-winning service has been recognized time and time again especially on this fantastic and relaxing journey. Guests aboard our Transatlantic cruises enjoy a wide range of on board activities. Transatlantic voyages are typically about 13 days, which means plenty of time to indulge in our 5-star Dream Cuisine, enjoy your favorite signature cocktail, or take advantage of our other remarkable and included amenities. Be sure to try something delightfully different, like our Raw or Living Food options. While crossing the Atlantic, you might spend time at the only Thai-Certified Spa at sea, participate in a round of golf in the Golf Simulator, or attend some of the guest speaker events on select voyages. Weather-permitting, you might even get to stop mid-voyage and enjoy a swim in the ocean right from our marina platform. Embarkation and arrival ports include: 
 San Juan, Puerto Rico 
 Charlotte Amalie, Saint Thomas 
 Bridgetown, Barbados 
 Funchal, Portugal 
 Lisbon, Portugal 
 Malaga, Spain 
Ready to kick back and enjoy the ocean views? Explore our Transatlantic Voyages. 
 View Transatlantic Voyages 
SeaDream Yachts 
Not a fan of crowds when you’re trying to relax on vacation? When you first board your yacht, you will immediately recognize the SeaDream difference on our luxury cruises. Each of our yachts feature only 56 ocean view staterooms, with a maximum guest capacity reaching just 112 guests. With 95 crew members, SeaDream provides nearly a 1:1 guest to crew ratio, which will exceed your expectations of what it means to be pampered on a luxury vacation. Every step of the way, the dedicated crew is there to help personalize your journey and ensure everything exceeds your satisfaction. With a yacht that is smaller than a traditional cruise ship , we don’t just offer a more intimate and personalized setting, we ‘re able to bring you to smaller ports and through waterways that would otherwise be unreachable by larger ships. To ensure you enjoy every moment of your vacation, our yachts offer a wide selection of amenities to keep you pampered. This includes our Dream Cuisine menu, which offers culinary delights from around the world to satiate your appetite. Beyond this 5-Star Dining experience, you also have access to our Top of the Yacht Bar and other features for your entertainment. Of course, relaxation is just one perk of sailing on SeaDream. When you contact your Travel Professional or call us now to request a voyage, we will ensure that your needs are met and we’ll begin to help personalize your cruising experience. 
On-Board Entertainment 
Offering the only Thai-Certified Spa at Sea , many guests start their journey by decompressing in this relaxing environment. Adjacent to this spa, you will find both the beauty salon and fitness center. This fitness center is fully equipped for your exercising needs, allowing you to maintain your workout routine on the open ocean. Our more athletic guests find that this is just the start of what we offer. On Deck 2, you’ll find the Watersports Marina Platform, allowing our guests access to some exciting activities during your voyage. The marina houses water toys such as kayaks, wave runners, snorkel gear, stand-up paddleboards, and more. When we reach port, you can select from an onboard fleet of mountain bikes and set off on a ride, giving you the freedom to get out and enjoy the area as you wish. If you head up to Deck 6, you can test out your skills “on the green” in our unique Golf Simulator, which offers a fun experience for golfers and non-golfers alike. Afterward, you might head to Deck 3 and cool down in the comfortably yacht-sized pool. While you’re enjoying a nice swim, you may enjoy a cocktail at the conveniently located pool bar or serviced by our highly anticipatory crew. 
As the day continues, be sure to visit the Topside Restaurant on Deck 5 and enjoy one of our gourmet meals from the Signature Dream Cuisine, which includes Raw, Living, and Vegan options for the holistic-minded guest. Afterwards, you can head to the library and check out a good book, or browse on the computer (sign up service required) or play a game of chess. Whether you prefer fiction or non-fiction literature, our extensive collection of over 1,200 books makes it easy to find one of interest. When the sun sets, you might head back to Deck 6 and lounge on one of our Signature Balinese Dream Beds. Our crew will make sure you have whatever you may need should you find yourself napping or just relaxing and enjoying the view. To wrap up just one of many perfect days on SeaDream, end the night by mingling with fellow guests at the Top of the Yacht Bar, singing karaoke at the Piano Bar or even catch a movie on a clear night outside. (Popcorn included!) 
Your Own Personal Stateroom 
Every stateroom onboard includes an ocean view and is your very own personal home away from home. Featuring an entertainment center with a flat-screen television and DVD player, you can enjoy a featured movie when you settle down for the night. You may also browse through our movie selection located at concierge for your comfortable night in. Each bathroom is marble-lined, with a multi-jet shower massage and Elm Organics bath amenities. Relax and get comfortable after a day full of adventure. With Belgian linens, plush blankets, and your selection of pillows, your bed will be made for personalized comfort. As you arise the next morning, you can slip into a SeaDream luxury bathrobe and accompanying slippers. 
Luxury Cruise – SeaDream Suite Options 
Our eight Commodore Suites combine two Yacht Club Staterooms for a more spacious travel experience. These suites include your choice of two twin beds or a single queen bed. They also offer two full baths and a seating area. Sit back and relax on the sofa, or enjoy a glass of champagne at your dining table. The Admiral Suite includes a spacious dining area, a master bedroom, one full and one half bath, and three panoramic windows providing breathtaking ocean views. To make the experience onboard extra special, guests can book The Owner’s Suite. This premium suite measures 447 square feet and like The Admiral suite, offers a separate master bedroom. The bedroom includes a queen size bed with its own bathroom. You can enjoy the special massage shower, separate soaking tub, and enjoy unmatched views of the sea in its sophisticated living and dining area.

Awards and Recognition 
Most recently, SeaDream has received the distinguished honor of being named for the 2017 edition of Berlitz Cruising and Cruise Ships . Both the SeaDream I and SeaDream II ranked in as #1 and #2 in “Best Boutique Ship” category. These yachts also received recognition for their placement in the Top 5 in Best for Food category. Of course, winning awards is nothing new to SeaDream and since our inception in 2001 we have a host of other awards and recognitions that we are equally proud of. You can see the full list with links here. SeaDream Yacht Club is honored to be awarded with some of the most prestigious awards and has been recognized time and again for its casually elegant yachting experience, the best crew, and our fine wine selections and gourmet cuisine. To demonstrate our continued dedication to providing this level of service, here is just a taste of our recent recognitions: 
2016 Awards and Recognition 
2016 has been an exciting year for our dedicated SeaDream crewmembers and our impeccable service and cuisine. We’ve been honored for the many awards such as Kreuzfahrt Guide Awards 2016 for the Best Cruise Ship of the Year for Service. Have you considered a romantic getaway? We’re proud to announce that we’ve been awarded for ‘Best Cruise Line for Couples’ by BRIDES.com. How can you resist experiencing such a memorable experience as Readers’ Choice also has recognized SeaDream in their list of “Best Cruise Lines.” Even for those looking for a great recreational activity, Golf Digest Editor’s Choice Awards has named SeaDream among the “Best Golf Cruise Lines.” Among other recognitions, World of Fine Wine Magazine acknowledged another premier service, awarding us a spot on the “World’s Best Wine List Awards 2016.” 
2015 Awards and Recognition 
In 2015, SeaDream was honored with another array of recognitions, and we are proud to acknowledge our crew for reaching USA Today’s “Top Cruise Ship Crews.” This same year, Virtuoso Travel named us “Best Niche Cruise Line,” and Travel Channel declared us to be the “Best Caribbean Cruise for 2015.” Perhaps our proudest achievement of 2015 is ForbesLife’s recognition of SeaDream for being “ Best Small Luxury Cruise Ship of 2015 .” As with previous years, SeaDream also received a Condé Nast Traveler Readers’ Choice Award and various other recognitions in this year. 
2013 and 2014 Awards and Recognition 
2013 marked a special year for SeaDream and the excitement of this year was solidified by the many recognitions and accolades we received. Travel + Leisure recognized us as one of the best all-inclusive cruises in the world and Cruise Critic even named us 2013 Top Luxury Line . The Telegraph featured SeaDream’s October 2013 Adriatic voyage as one of the six Best Luxury Cruises. Both Fox News and the Chicago Tribune also recognized SeaDream that year, placing it in the “Top 10 Cruise Lines,” and “Ten Best Luxury Cruise Ships Afloat,” respectively. And, this is just a few of the awards received in that year, which also included multiple recognitions by Condé Nast Traveler. We’re continuously providing the best experience possible with new ways to ensure our luxury cruise vacations could exceed guest expectations. Newsweek’s Best of the Best Places to Visit in 2014 recognized SeaDream I as “Cruise of the Year,” a highly sought after award. The Bon Voyage Awards also named SeaDream Yacht Club the “Best for Couples,” that year. Perhaps most important, the Condé Nast Traveler Gold List recognized SeaDream as the top Ocean cruise of 2014. 
Your SeaDream Inclusive Ammenties 
When you book a luxury cruise with SeaDream, you reserve an inclusive experience that includes many aspects of the onboard yachting lifestyle. All ocean view staterooms, Dream Cuisine gourmet meals, included gratuities, and open bar with select premium spirits and wines make up just a taste of what you will enjoy on a SeaDream Yacht Club vacation. We strive to personalize your experience as our crew goes above and beyond to ensure every detail is perfect. So, what other amenities will you enjoy while on board? 
Every Meal is On Us 
Our expert chefs prepare all meals a la minute for the best quality, flavor and presentation. Throughout the day, you’ll enjoy open seating in the Dining Salon or in an open-air atmosphere at the Topside Restaurant. If you work up an appetite and wish to stay in your stateroom, you can check your fully stocked mini-fridge. When a snack just won’t do, you can also take advantage of the inclusive in-suite menu. With 24-hour room service available, you can order what you like, when you like. Our chefs are happy to accommodate most dietary restrictions, so let us know if there are special requirements for your gourmet meals. Gratuities are covered, so sit back and enjoy our excellent dining experience with the best crew at sea. 
Onboard Included Activities 
While the 5-Star Dining experience is a guest favorite, our Club Members also enjoy the many included active lifestyle amenities. Both of our mega-yachts have their own Watersports Platform Marina, which includes a full range of water toys, accessories and gear that you can enjoy in select ports. Or you may workout in the yacht’s Fitness Center, which includes treadmills, recumbent bikes, free weights, and we also feature daily morning Yoga or Tai Chi on deck. When shore side, SeaDream offers mountain bikes, which are available for our guests to use on their or along with our Activities staff on a complimentary hiking or biking excursions in select destinations. For those who wish to spend time onboard, guests can always enjoy the Golf Simulator that includes 30 signature courses, giving you the opportunity to work on your long game, even while at sea. 
Plenty of On-board Entertainment 
With a television and DVD player in each stateroom, there is always an opportunity to unwind and relax to your favorite movie. But, this is just the beginning of the many entertainment options. Your yacht also has a fully-stocked library, which includes over 1,200 books for you to choose from. If reading isn’t on your list, there is also a full Media and Entertainment library as well as laptop computers for on-board use. As you travel through some of those more idyllic locations, you can enjoy our open deck and utilize our hidden high-powered binoculars to get a closer view. (Hint: They’re located in a drawer at the back of the yacht!) The saltwater pool and fresh water Jacuzzi are always a great idea as well, offering the perfect place to relax throughout the day. When night arrives, you might join some of your fellow guests for Starlit Movies® on the deck, allowing you to watch a featured film while appreciating the night sky. Afterwards, you might even decide to stay on deck and lay in one of the Signature Balinese Dream Bed and watch the stars go by. 
Your Bar Tab Is Covered 
Select premium spirits and wines round-out the perfect inclusive experience. Enjoy tales of past travels from your fellow yachtsmen at the Top of the Yacht Bar, or sing along to your favorite tune in the Piano Bar. On a SeaDream Yacht Club vacation, the entertainment and bar service is included. 
Ready to sit back and relax and not worry about pulling your wallet out? Start your luxury cruise experience today.

Private Yacht Charter 
SeaDream’s two identical mega-yachts are the perfect size for private family and corporate events. Since inception in 2001, SeaDream is proud to have been chosen to be the premier provider of private yacht cruises for the most discerning guests and corporate customers. With a SeaDream Charter, you can customize the itinerary, plan special on-board programming, and influence every aspect of the experience. You’ll enjoy the attentive service and advice from your own dedicated Charter Coordinator. Private charters are the perfect way to experience the yachts to their fullest which are well-suited for a variety of occasions. Whether 112 guests or just 50, you’ll enjoy the service of a full crew compliment of 95 which means superior personalized service and attention to detail. The intimate setting of a yacht is perfect for those special occasions and will satisfy anyone’s individual preferences. 
Host Your Business Event 
With a capacity of 112 guests available, many clients have held annual corporate events aboard SeaDream. A SeaDream vacation provides a real incentive for your corporate team and delivers a wonderful moral boost while building team spirit. You can conduct important meetings in one of the various meeting spaces capable of holding all 112 guests or you can just use this as a getaway to reward your staff for a job well done. Alternatively, business owners also find that a private charter is the perfect way to offer a luxury cruise for customer appreciation. Get your core staff and your top clients together on board, offering them a view of what the future holds while thanking them for their continued support. With all of the included amenities they receive on board, you can be sure of a strengthening your business relationships. If you want a business trip that you won’t soon forget, make sure to contact us to setup a private yacht charter. 
Private Parties 
Closed a big business deal that will allow you to expand the reach of your company? Just sold your company and ready to start a new stage in your life? Feeling like it is time to plan a big family reunion? Life is full of reasons to celebrate, so why not do it in a way that you can truly relax. By booking a private yacht charter for your party, you can get those all-inclusive options you need and not have to worry about a thing while at sea. See those locations you’ve always dreamed of and create memories that will last a lifetime. The primary reason many Club Members come back to us for their own private parties is that SeaDream creates a truly intimate and memorable experience. Invite the family members you want, or just those close friends who helped you get where you are today. Since you get to control the guest list, you know everyone on board and get to enjoy a tight-knit community throughout the voyage. Best of all, you get to choose special entertainment if you wish, allowing you to enjoy a custom experience that you can’t find elsewhere. 
Weddings 
There is no event more special than a wedding. On private wedding charter, you can customize the decor, food and drink menu, plan special on-board events, and even arrange custom entertainment should you wish. The one thing we can promise: everyone will remember your wedding aboard a SeaDream yacht. Options for this private charter are up to your imagination. Perhaps you want a classic Caribbean feel and location-inspired menu. We can arrange that and arrange the stops at some of the most intimate harbors in the region. Or, maybe you wish to hold the wedding in open waters, sailing through the Atlantic and stopping afterwards to swim in the open ocean. Interested in live music? Fireworks? Whatever your dream, we can make it a reality. Those who want the perfect wedding experience should contact us to setup a private charter today. 
Unique Programs 
With our many inclusive options, intimate service, and an Award-Winning Crew, SeaDream already provides one of the most unique travel experiences available. While this might be sufficient for some guests, we understand that enough is almost never really enough. This is why our voyages offers a plethora of unique programs that you can take advantage of.

If you are in the Caribbean, this might include a private sailboat charter when we make port. In the Mediterranean, this could be a hiking tour of many of the most historically significant sights. The SeaDream Lifestyle 
While often referred to as a “luxury cruise” SeaDream wants to make one thing clear: “It’s Yachting, Not Cruising.” We make this statement not just because of the size of our mega-yachts, but also for the personalized experience our guests enjoy aboard. When you choose to be a guest on a SeaDream Yacht Club vacation, you are setting your standards high. By voyaging with us, you are choosing to enjoy a more luxurious and intimate setting than you will find on most luxury cruise ships . Instead, you will feel like this is your own private yacht and every member of our 95-person crew is there to see that your needs are met. Luxury meets casual elegance – this is yachting. 
It’s About the Experience 
Smaller is better. Our yachts are small enough that they can fit through passages that others would be unable to travel. More important, this size grants us access to intimate ports and special locations that others might only dream of reaching. With 95 crew members for 112 guests, you will find that there is always someone standing by to ensure you have everything you need on the journey.

Preparing meals a la minute, our chefs provide you with the freshest and most delicious meals on the open ocean. Each multi-course meal is planned with elegant and light portions in mind along with a paired wine to ensure the experience is completely enjoyable. Those with food allergies or special dietary needs will also find that our menu is diverse and pleasing. Our chefs understand raw ingredients like no others and are ready to deliver some of the most delectable meals you have ever enjoyed. With an open bar and select premium brands available, you can always follow up your meal with an exceptional selection of beverages.

SeaDream Yacht Club, celebrating its 15th anniversary and named “Best Niche Cruise Line” at the prestigious Virtuoso Awards, has achieved the industry’s highest accolades for its two twin, casually elegant mega-yachts, SeaDream I and SeaDream II. An incredible array of services, activities, water toys, dining, wine, premium drinks and gratuities are provided in SeaDream’s inclusive fare.

Stay aboard the yacht for the entire journey or take advantage of some of our exciting land adventures. Whatever choice you make, you’ll be glad to call yourself a Club Member of SeaDream Yacht Club. Wellness at Sea: Relax, Restore & Live Well 
 Wellness aboard SeaDream begins with a sense of ease. The pace softens, the air feels lighter, and each day unfolds with space to focus on what matters most. From quiet moments on deck to movement, nourishment, and restoration, wellness becomes part of the natural rhythm of life at sea.   
 This is wellness by the sea, where open horizons replace crowded spaces, and every experience invites you to feel balanced, restored, and fully present in a true luxury spa at sea environment. Aboard SeaDream, wellness is not a program, it is simply a way of life.  
Yoga, Fitness & Wellness Activities at Sea 
 Each day begins gently, often with sunrise yoga or Tai Chi as the light shifts across the water. Movement feels different here. The sea sets the tempo, and the open air invites you to slow down and reconnect. These sessions are complimentary for all guests and require no prior experience. Simply arrive, breathe, and let the movement begin.
 For those seeking a more active routine, SeaDream’s newly renovated fitness center offers a modern yacht gym experience with ocean views at every turn. Equipped with treadmills, elliptical bikes, free weights, and functional training equipment, it allows you to maintain your personal fitness routine while surrounded by the sea.  
 You may also take to the open deck, where a simple walk or run becomes something more. Sixteen laps around Deck 6 marks a mile, with uninterrupted views guiding each step. After movement, relax in the steam room, a quiet luxury that defines life aboard a yacht with a sauna.
 Whether through mindful practice or daily movement, yacht fitness aboard SeaDream is designed to feel natural, unhurried, and deeply connected to your surroundings, redefining wellness by the sea.   
SeaDream Spa & Salon 
Tucked quietly onboard, the SeaDream Spa offers a refined Spa at sea experience where relaxation comes effortlessly. As the only Thai-certified yacht club spa at sea, it brings a level of authenticity and expertise that sets it apart. Our massage therapists hold recognized Thai spa and wellness certifications, ensuring every treatment meets the highest standard of care. 
Here, wellness is both restorative and immersive. Skilled therapists offer a full range of luxury yacht spa services, including traditional Thai massages on yachts, soothing aromatherapy, radiant facials, and detoxifying treatments. Each treatment is part of a complete yacht experience designed around relaxation, movement, and recovery.   
For those wishing to explore further, enjoy a curated selection of spa treatments and salon services designed for complete relaxation. Treatments are available daily from 8 AM to 8 PM and can be reserved through the onboard spa team.  
 Explore Our Spa & Salon 
Plant-Based & Organic Cuisine 
Wellness continues at the table, where fresh, seasonal ingredients are thoughtfully prepared to help you feel balanced, energized, and restored.   
SeaDream offers a thoughtful selection of plant-based and living foods cuisine, with nutrient-rich dishes that support your health while remaining vibrant and satisfying. Each meal is designed to feel light, nourishing, and in harmony with the rhythm of wellness by the sea.   
Our plant-based menu is crafted by SeaDream's culinary team using seasonal, sustainably sourced ingredients. Guests with dietary preferences including vegan, gluten-free, or allergen-specific requirements are accommodated with care. Simply let us know before or during your voyage.

Your Guests Deserve the Best 
Recognized for our luxury service and impeccable presentation, our guests quickly discover that a voyage on board one of our modernized yachts is unlike any other. 
Countless Destinations to Discover 
When you plan a private yacht charter with SeaDream, you have the freedom to choose where in the Caribbean or Mediterranean you wish to travel. Whether you select one of our existing, 7- to 14-day itineraries, or decide to customize your ports of call, your dedicated Charter Specialist can help develop an itinerary that fits your needs and desires. This way, you are in complete control of the voyage, including special requests for cuisine, onboard entertainment, enriching and engaging activities, and more.

Unlimited Customization 
Beyond just selecting your ports of call, you’ll have the opportunity to make other important travel decisions. With an array of inclusive options, you can enjoy every moment at sea. Perhaps you wish to have some tailored onboard entertainment, a specialty 5-star menu and curated wine list, a live presentation for your guests, or a distinct thematic decor. Whatever you envision, share it with your Charter Specialist. We’ll go above and beyond to make sure your vision becomes reality.  
Well-Appointed Accommodations 
Alongside our modernized onboard amenities and inclusive options, our twin yachts feature 56 staterooms for your guests to enjoy. Staterooms and suites are designed to complement your casually elegant private yacht journey and provide a comfortable,  luxurious sanctuary. 
Perfect for Any Occasion 
Since you control your private charter and guest list, any occasion is the perfect occasion. Business owners and executives frequently plan special voyages for their valued employees or to offer a more casual training atmosphere. While on the open sea, our yachts have meetings spaces large enough to accommodate all of your 112 guests. This provides the perfect setting for presentations and onboard seminars if you so choose. Alternatively, you can use the time for team-building or simple relaxation.
